Tosafot on Bava Batra 131b:1:1.hebrew: דלמא בתרי בי דינא איתקון - פירוש: דספיקא הוי אי אמר בבריא אי לא. ולר"י נראה דבבריא נמי אמר, מדאמר רבי נתן: "שניתם משנתכם" כר' יוחנן בן ברוקה:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 131b:1:1.english: "Perhaps they were instituted in two courts" - Explanation: It is a doubt whether he said [this] while healthy or not. But it appears to Ri that he said [this] also in the case of a healthy person, since Rabbi Natan said, "You have changed your teaching," in accordance with Rabbi Yochanan ben Beroka.
